title: Social Media and Ad Creative Manager
description:
ABOUT US



Vitae Glass is a premium, modular glass accessories brand based in San Francisco, with a real environmental mission - we plant a tree for every unit sold. We're a design-led DTC company, and we're looking for a talented marketer to own our social media and ad creative. 



(Our brand is in the 420 sector, you must be comfortable/have experience with the plant. )



THE ROLE



You'll be the creative engine behind our marketing. Your #1 job is producing high-quality ad creatives - static images and short-form video - and running them profitably on Meta and TikTok. You'll also manage our Instagram day to day, including commenting and engaging with our community.



What you'll own:



 • Ad creative production (your main focus) - static image ads and short-form video

/Instagram) and TikTok

, Pinterest

 • Reporting - tracking ROAS, CAC, and sales



YOU MUST HAVE



 • Fluent written English - you'll be commenting and engaging publicly, unsupervised

 • A premium, tasteful sensibility - this is a wellness-forward brand, not a meme page

Bonus (not required): experience advertising a restricted/regulated category.

title: Visual Design Lead (Remote, Full-Time)
description:
Company: LocalMarketingAudit

Work Setup: Remote | Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Timezone Preference: Overlap with US business hours | Eastern Time (at least 3–4 hours)



We are 
, a new and growing marketing agency focused on helping local businesses thrive. As we build our core team, we are looking for a talented, detail-oriented, and creative Visual Design Lead to become the foundation of our visual brand.



This is a long-term, full-time remote role with significant growth potential. You will play a critical role in translating our brand voice and marketing strategy into clear, compelling, and conversion-focused visuals across all platforms.

This is not a "task-only" design role. We are looking for someone who thinks in systems, consistency, and outcomes, not just aesthetics.



What Success Looks Like in This Role (First 90 Days):

Our brand visuals feel cohesive, recognizable, and professional across all channels.

Core Canva templates are finalized and actively used by the team.

Social and ad creatives are delivered on time, on-brand, and iteration-ready.

Video content has a consistent visual style optimized for short-form platforms.

AI-generated product videos (using Higgsfield) are produced regularly for our ecommerce clients.

Founder communication becomes more strategic because execution is reliable.



Your Responsibilities:

Own and develop our visual brand identity. You will define, document, and maintain our color palette, typography, imagery style, and visual standards to ensure brand consistency across all assets.

Create client brand guidelines from scratch. You will work across multiple client accounts at the same time, building complete brand guidelines for each client (logo usage, color palette, typography, imagery style, and templates) and keeping every client's assets consistent with their own brand.

Design high-impact marketing assets. This includes social media graphics (carousels, banners, posts), audit reports, presentation decks, digital ad creatives, and simple website graphics used across internal and client-facing touchpoints.

Build and manage reusable design systems. You will create scalable templates, asset libraries, and design frameworks in Canva to improve speed, quality, and repeatability.

Produce short-form video content. You will edit and produce Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok videos, handling clean cuts, text overlays, captions, and basic motion graphics.

Create AI-generated ecommerce product videos. You will use Higgsfield to produce product showcase videos, product demos, and UGC-style ad videos for ecommerce brands.

Collaborate directly with the founder. You will translate concepts, briefs, and strategic direction into finished visuals while proactively suggesting improvements and creative ideas.

Prepare for future team leadership. As the company grows, you may help onboard, review, and guide junior designers to maintain standards and output quality.



Must-Have Requirements:

Portfolio is REQUIRED. Applications without a portfolio link will not be considered. Your portfolio must show social media graphics, brand identity work, and at least basic video samples.

Expert-level proficiency in Canva, plus strong working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.

Strong short-form video editing skills using CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar tools.

Hands-on experience creating videos with Higgsfield, especially ecommerce product videos (product showcases, demos, or UGC-style ads).

Excellent visual judgment. You understand layout, spacing, hierarchy, typography, color theory, and can explain your design choices.

Clear written English communication skills. You can give and receive feedback professionally.

Highly dependable and self-managed. You meet deadlines, organize your workload, and communicate blockers early.

Stable internet connection and a dedicated, quiet workspace.



Nice-to-Haves:

Experience in a marketing agency, startup, or fast-paced environment.

Familiarity with Webflow, Framer, or WordPress.

Understanding of creative performance for LinkedIn,
, and Instagram ads and organic posts.

Experience creating or following brand guidelines.

Experience with other AI creative tools for image or video generation.



Work Style & Expectations:

You are comfortable working remotely with minimal hand-holding.

You value brand consistency over personal style.

You are open to feedback and iteration.

You think in terms of systems, templates, and scalability, not one-off designs.

You communicate progress clearly and proactively.



Growth & Opportunities:

Opportunity to become Head of Design as the company scales.

Increased ownership and leadership responsibilities over time.

Long-term role in shaping a growing brand from the ground up.



How to Apply:

To confirm you've read this entire post, start your application with the phrase "AUDIT READY."

Please include:

Your updated CV/Resume

A link to your portfolio (required)

At least one Higgsfield video sample, ideally an ecommerce product video

A short explanation of 1–2 design projects you're most proud of and why

Your answer to: "What does brand consistency mean to you in practical terms?"

Monthly salary expectation



Our Hiring Process:



Application Review (portfolio is critical)

Initial Short Interview (Google Meet)

Paid Test Project (we compensate you for real work)

Final Interview & Offerr

Just beginning to learn GoHighLevel

title: Full Stack Developer and AI Automation Specialist
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer — E-Mobility & AI-Enabled Web Applications



FULL STACK DEVELOPER — AI-ENABLED WEB APPLICATIONS



Location: Remote (Philippines-based)



Position Type: Part-time to start, with a path to full-time based on performance and fit



Schedule: Aligned with U.S. Eastern Time (EST/New York); minimum 4-hour daily overlap required



Team Context: You'll join a remote team that includes an AI automation specialist (n8n, Open Claw, agent orchestration).

This role is the application-development counterpart to that function — you build the products; your teammate builds the automation glue around them. Expect close collaboration, not overlap.



POSITION OVERVIEW



We're looking for a strong/experienced full stack developer to design, build, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications in the electric mobility (eMobility) space — think fleet electrification dashboards, multimodal routing tools, EV education platforms, and data-driven CMS-backed sites. You'll work at the intersection of product engineering and applied AI, implementing your coding skills with tools like Claude Code, Codex/GPT, and Kimi K3 as coding and research accelerants — not as a crutch, but as a way to move faster and keep costs down. The person filling this role would also need to stay abreast of the latest updates and tools utilized in the sector. 



This is a builder role first. You should love and have experience writing clean, maintainable code, care about security, performance, and speed and be comfortable owning a feature/project from database schema to deployed UI. AI fluency is a strong plus, not the core job.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Application Development (Primary Focus)

Design and build full stack web applications and dashboards— React/Next.js (or similar) front ends connected to Node.js/Python back ends

Design and build internal systems and automations to streamline team workflows 

Architect and manage relational and/or NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Firebase, Supabase) for data-intensive tools (e.g., fleet electrification calculators, EV range/charging models)

Build and maintain CMS-backed sites (Wix, headless, or custom CMS) with clean content workflows for non-technical stakeholders

Connect web apps to cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure, or Vercel/Render-style platforms) with attention to uptime, scalability, and cost

Implement authentication, role-based access, and security best practices appropriate for enterprise clients (OWASP basics, secure API design, data encryption at rest/in transit)

Write and maintain REST/GraphQL APIs and webhook integrations that your automation-focused teammate can plug into



AI-Accelerated Development

Use AI coding assistants (Claude, Codex, Cursor, Kimi K3, etc.) to accelerate development while maintaining code quality and review discipline - reviewing code before it is deployed

Exercise judgment on model selection — knowing when a lightweight/cheap model is "good enough" for boilerplate vs. when a task needs a frontier model is necessary

Collaborate with the team's AI automation specialist to expose clean APIs/webhooks so n8n and agent-based workflows can interact with your applications



SEO & GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)

Implement technical SEO fundamentals (site speed, structured data/schema markup, semantic HTML, sitemaps, Core Web Vitals) into everything you build

Apply GEO principles so content and app pages are legible to AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) — clean information architecture, clear factual statements, structured data



Quality & Operations

Perform regular health/security audits on deployed applications and databases

Maintain documentation for architecture, environment setup, and deployment processes

Troubleshoot integration issues between your applications, the CMS, and third-party/automation tools



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Internet: High-speed connection (min. 50 Mbps) with documented backup (secondary ISP or mobile hotspot)

Computer: Mac preferred, 16GB RAM minimum (32GB+ preferred), Apple Silicon or Intel i7/i9

Audio/Video: Professional noise-canceling headset, HD webcam

Power: UPS for outage continuity

Workspace: Quiet, dedicated home office



QUALIFICATIONS

Required

3+ years professional full stack development experience, with a portfolio or GitHub showing real shipped applications (not just tutorials/clones)

Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript; comfortable in at least one back-end language (Node.js, Python, or Go)

Hands-on experience with at least one modern front-end framework (React, Vue, or Next.js)

Experience designing and querying relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and comfort with at least one NoSQL option

Experience deploying and maintaining applications on cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure/Vercel)

Practical, hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, or similar) in a real production workflow

Working understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, and JSON — enough to integrate cleanly with an automation layer (n8n) built by a teammate

Solid grasp of web security fundamentals (auth, input validation, secrets management, HTTPS/SSL)

Exceptional written and verbal English for a U.S.-facing corporate environment



Strongly Preferred

Experience with CMS platforms — Wix Velo, Webflow, WordPress, or headless CMS (Sanity, Contentful, Strapi)

Familiarity with SEO/technical SEO and emerging GEO practices

Exposure to n8n, Zapier, Make.com, or similar — enough to speak the same language as an automation-focused teammate, even if it's not your core job

Experience with data visualization/dashboarding (D3, Recharts, Chart.js) — relevant for fleet/energy data tools

Background in EV, energy, mobility, clean tech, or logistics sectors

Experience with real-time data (WebSockets, MQTT) — relevant for fleet telemetry or charging-status use cases

Familiarity with basic DevOps/CI-CD (GitHub Actions, Docker)



Nice to Have

Mobile app experience (React Native/Flutter) if the roadmap expands to a driver/fleet-manager app

Experience with mapping/geospatial tools (Mapbox, Google Maps API, Leaflet) — common in fleet/routing tools

Prior experience working in a fully remote, async, US-hours-aligned team



APPLICATION PROCESS

Submit your application here: 



Make sure to include your resume/CV, a portfolio or GitHub link, and a cover letter answering:



Describe a full stack application you built end-to-end (front end, back end, database, deployment). What was the hardest technical decision, and why did you make it that way?



Describe a specific instance where you used an AI coding tool to meaningfully speed up a real project — what did you do, and where did you still need to step in and correct or refine the output?



(Optional but a plus) If you have any exposure to automation platforms like n8n, Zapier, or Make, briefly describe how you'd expose your application's data to one of those tools.



Also submit a 1–2 minute Loom-style video introducing yourself, walking through one project in your portfolio, and explaining why this role fits you.

HeartStamp is a US brand that helps people create personalized greeting cards. Customers can have them printed and mailed, or send them digitally, and we also do invitations and gifts. You'll turn raw footage into short-form videos and ads that people watch all the way through, every working day.

-Build paid ads from multiple sources, including UGC, B-roll, product shots and screen recordings.

-Turn one winning ad into a batch of testable versions with new hooks in the first 2 to 3 seconds, different pacing, captions, text overlays and calls to action.

-Re-cut ads for each platform's size, length and safe zones, and quickly refresh ads that are wearing out with a new intro, trim or overlay.

-Burn in captions for sound-off viewing, and place animated callouts and graphics from our in-house kit.

-Edit YouTube and tutorial videos and brand sizzle reels, including product walkthroughs recorded from our website and iPhone app.

-After we train you on our tools, produce short generative video clips and light motion graphics for our website.

Keep a tidy, tagged footage library so every new version is fast to build.



Must have:

-A real feel for hooks. You know the first two seconds d
 whether anyone keeps watching.

CapCut fluency. We provide CapCut. Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or After Effects on your own license is a plus.

-Strong written English, quick replies on Slack, and a written daily standup every working day.

-Availability for our daily overlap: Monday to Friday, 11:00 AM to 2:00 PM US Eastern. That's 11:00 PM to 2:00 AM Philippine time now, and 12:00 AM to 3:00 AM from November 1.

Nice to have:

-Experience with generative video tools such as Runway, Kling, Veo or Seedance.

-Motion graphics or animated website elements.

-Past work for family, gifting or e-commerce brands.



How we work: Our Social Media Manager and Paid Ads lead will direct your day-to-day work, and our founder gives final approval. Everything runs on written briefs in Notion and Slack. If a brief is unclear, ask before guessing.



How to apply: Every hire starts with a short paid test at your hourly rate. Please send:

title: Senior Full Stack Developer | AU Client
description:
​​​​We are seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer with a strong backend focus to design, develop, and maintain scalable web applications and services supporting our platform's core business operations. This role is responsible for building and maintaining secure, high-performance backend systems using Java and Spring Boot, while also contributing to frontend development to support end-to-end feature delivery.

Working closely with the Head of Engineering, product stakeholders, and cross-functional teams, the successful candidate will own features from architecture through deployment, with particular emphasis on backend system design, database architecture, and multi-tenant data handling. This role also requires clear, confident communication, as the candidate will regularly collaborate with international team members and may be required to speak directly with clients and customers.



Responsibilities

Backend Development: Design, develop, and maintain scalable REST APIs and backend services using Java and Spring Boot.

Frontend Contribution: Build and maintain frontend features and interfaces using React (or an equivalent modern framework), ensuring smooth integration with backend services.

Database Architecture: Design, maintain, and optimise PostgreSQL databases, including relational data models and multi-tenant data segregation strategies (e.g., application-level tenancy vs. row-level security).

Systems Integration: Build and maintain integrations with third-party services and internal APIs to support business workflows.

Application Security: Apply secure software development practices, including authentication, authorization, and data segregation across tenants/clients.

Code Quality: Produce clean, maintainable, and well-documented code while participating in peer reviews and development best practices.

Client & Team Communication: Communicate clearly and confidently with engineering leadership, distributed teams, and clients as required, including verbal communication in English.

Project Collaboration: Work within an Agile environment, providing regular updates on development progress, technical decisions, and challenges.



Requirements

Minimum 4 years of proven commercial experience developing backend applications using Java and Spring Boot.

Strong, current, hands-on experience with the most recent stable versions of Spring Boot (not solely early-career or outdated exposure).

Strong experience designing and developing REST APIs.

Solid PostgreSQL database design and optimisation skills, including a clear understanding of multi-tenant data architecture (application-level tenancy vs. PostgreSQL row-level security).

Working experience with a modern frontend framework (React strongly preferred), with demonstrated project experience, not solely listed familiarity.

Experience deploying containerised applications using Docker.

Good understanding of application security principles and secure development practices.

Strong verbal and written English communication skills, with confidence discussing technical concepts with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including clients.

Experience using AI-assisted software development tools is highly regarded.



Software Proficiency

Programming Languages – Java

Frameworks – Spring Boot

Frontend – React (or equivalent modern framework)

Containerisation – Docker

Database Technologies – PostgreSQL

API Technologies – REST APIs

AI Development Tools – GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, or equivalent



Education

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

title: Real Estate Content & Marketing Virtual Assistant
description:
# Real Estate Content & Marketing Virtual Assistant



**Remote — Philippines | 20–40 Hours per Week | $8 USD per Hour**



## About the Role



Andrew Freed is a multifamily real estate investor, real estate agent, podcast host, and community builder. We are hiring a creative, organized, and proactive Virtual Assistant to help manage and grow his personal brand.



This role combines **content creation, video editing, social media management, podcast support, event coordination, and real estate marketing**. The ideal candidate can take raw ideas, videos, voice notes, property updates, and podcast content and turn them into polished marketing assets.



## Key Responsibilities



### Content Creation and Editing



* Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok,
, LinkedIn, and YouTube Shorts.

* Create podcast clips, captions, hooks, thumbnails, carousels, quote graphics, and educational posts.

* Turn long-form podcast episodes and videos into multiple pieces of short-form content.

* Write social media captions, LinkedIn posts, short video scripts,
 copy, and content outlines in Andrew’s voice.

* Review content for spelling, branding, formatting, audio quality, and overall professionalism.

* Maintain consistent fonts, colors, logos, messaging, and brand standards across all materials.

* Organize raw footage, completed edits, graphics, captions, and final approved assets.



### Social Media Management



* Maintain a weekly and monthly content calendar.

* Schedule approved content through Buffer.

* Manage posting across
, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, and TikTok.

* Help launch, optimize, and manage Andrew’s TikTok account.

* Format content appropriately for each platform rather than posting the exact same version everywhere.

* Add captions, hashtags, tags, links, thumbnails, and calls to action.

* Monitor comments and direct messages and route important inquiries to the correct team member.

* Track basic analytics, identify high-performing topics, and recommend new content ideas.

* Confirm that scheduled posts publish correctly and fix formatting or link issues when needed.



### Podcast Support



* Help identify and research potential podcast guests.

* Coordinate guest outreach, scheduling, reminders, and follow-up.

* Collect guest biographies, headshots, social links, and promotional materials.

* Prepare basic guest briefing documents and interview questions.

* Coordinate with podcast editors and monitor episode deadlines.

* Create episode titles, descriptions, show notes, timestamps, social captions, and promotional clips.

* Send guests completed marketing assets when their episodes are published.

* Maintain an organized podcast guest and production tracker.



### Monthly Real Estate Meetup



* Help coordinate Andrew’s monthly real estate meetup.

* Contact and schedule speakers, panelists, sponsors, and guests.

* Collect speaker headshots, biographies, topics, and presentation materials.

* Create event graphics, social media posts,
 announcements, registration materials, and reminder communications.

* Help build and update presentation slide decks.

* Prepare speaker introductions, agendas, sponsor slides, and run-of-show documents.

* Track registrations and maintain attendee lists.

* Create post-event recaps, photos, short videos, and follow-up content.

* Follow up with speakers, sponsors, and attendees after the event.



### Off-Market Property Marketing



* Create professional marketing materials for off-market real estate opportunities.

* Develop property flyers, one-page summaries, social graphics,
 campaigns, and presentation decks.

* Organize property photos, rent rolls, financial details, maps, and investment highlights.

* Verify that addresses, pricing, rents, contact information, and property details are accurate before publication.

* Coordinate with Andrew and the real estate team to obtain missing information.

* Prepare materials for social media,
 lists, investor groups, and direct buyer outreach.

* Maintain a tracker of available, upcoming, under-contract, and sold properties.



### Project and Team Coordination



* Track assignments, approvals, deadlines, and outstanding items.

* Follow up when materials or deliverables are late.

* Turn meetings and voice notes into organized tasks and action items.

* Maintain shared folders and keep files clearly labeled and easy to locate.

* Provide a concise weekly report covering:



 * Content published

 * Content in production

 * Upcoming podcast episodes

 * Meetup status

 * Property-marketing projects

 * Missed deadlines or bottlenecks

 * Items requiring Andrew’s approval

* Proactively identify problems and recommend solutions.



## Required Qualifications



* Strong written and spoken English.

* Experience creating and editing social media content.

* Video editing experience using CapCut, Adobe Premiere, Descript, or similar software.

* Strong Canva and presentation-design skills.

* Experience managing
, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, or YouTube.

* Familiarity with Buffer or another social media scheduling platform.

* Strong organizational and project-management skills.

* Excellent attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.

* Ability to work independently with limited supervision.

* Reliable computer, internet connection, and backup plan.

* Availability for partial overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience supporting a personal brand, entrepreneur, podcast, real estate investor, brokerage, or property-management company.

* Knowledge of multifamily investing, house hacking, cash flow, NOI, cap rates, rent rolls, value-add investing, and syndications.

* Experience creating real estate flyers or property-marketing packages.

* Experience coordinating podcasts, events, meetups, or webinars.

* Familiarity with Google Drive, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, and project-management tools.

* Ability to turn rough ideas and raw materials into polished content with minimal direction.



## Ideal Candidate



You are creative but highly organized. You can edit a video, create a graphic, write a caption, coordinate a podcast guest, and keep multiple projects moving at the same time.



You take ownership, communicate clearly, follow up consistently, catch mistakes before publication, and suggest improvements instead of waiting for every instruction.



## Application Requirements



Please submit:

title: Etsy Growth & Store Manager – Digital Products
description:
I am looking for an experienced, commercially minded Etsy Growth & Store Manager to take ownership of an existing digital-products store.



This is not a basic VA, data-entry or listing-upload role.



The store sells digital spreadsheet products, primarily Excel and Google Sheets templates. It currently has an established catalogue but is significantly underperforming, generating only around US$30 per month in normal sales.



I believe the store has considerably more potential and am looking for someone who can bring a fresh approach, identify what is holding it back and turn it into a commercially successful store.



Initial 4-month growth sprint



The initial engagement will be a four-month growth sprint, working up to 20 hours per week.



If we achieve strong results, my intention is for this to develop into a long-term Store Manager position, with increased responsibility, additional resources and the opportunity for compensation to grow with the store.



I care much more about results than simply hours worked.



What you will do

You will take ownership of the store's growth, including:

- Analyse the existing store, listings and performance

- Identify why products are or are not selling

- Etsy SEO and keyword research

- Competitor and market research

- Identify new product opportunities

- Improve product positioning, pricing and bundles

- Improve thumbnails, titles, descriptions and tags

- Analyse traffic and conversion

- Test ideas and measure results

- Identify products that should be improved, expanded or discontinued

- Help develop new digital-product concepts

- Make basic to intermediate improvements to Excel and Google Sheets products when required

- Provide a simple weekly update covering results, work completed, findings and next priorities



I am not looking for someone who waits for a daily task list.



I want someone who can look at the store, understand what the numbers are saying, identify opportunities and tell me what we should do next.



The person I am looking for

You should have:

- Proven experience growing Etsy stores

- Strong understanding of Etsy SEO, conversion and product research

- Experience with digital products

- Strong commercial judgement

- Confidence analysing store performance and making recommendations

- Good working knowledge of Excel and/or Google Sheets

- Ability to make changes to spreadsheet products where required

- Strong written English

- Reliable communication

- A proactive, ownership-focused approach



Your ability to grow an Etsy store is more important than being an advanced spreadsheet developer.



As the store grows, I intend to add specialist product-development support so that the Store Manager can focus increasingly on growth and commercial performance.



Compensation

US$8–10/hour depending on experience

Up to 20 hours per week initially

Performance bonuses in addition to hourly pay

The role includes one-off bonuses for reaching new monthly sales milestones:

- US$250 sales = US$25 bonus

- US$500 = US$50

- US$1,000 = US$100

- US$2,000 = US$200

- US$3,000 = US$300

- US$5,000 = US$500

- US$10,000 = US$1,000



The incentive structure will continue at higher revenue levels as the store grows.



If multiple new milestones are reached in the same month, all applicable milestone bonuses will be paid.



For example, if sales move from US$500/month to US$2,000/month, the US$1,000 and US$2,000 bonuses would both be paid.



There is significant upside for someone who can genuinely scale the business.



To apply

Please answer the following questions in your application:

1. Tell me about an Etsy store you have personally helped grow.

What were sales like before you became involved, what did they grow to, how long did it take, and what did you personally change?

2. If you inherited an Etsy digital-products store currently generating around US$30–40/month, what would you do in your first 30 days?

3. How do you determine whether an Etsy listing has a traffic problem, SEO problem, conversion problem or product problem?

4. Tell me about a digital product you have helped successfully launch or improve.

5. What experience do you have with Excel and Google Sheets?

You do not need to be an advanced spreadsheet developer, but you should be comfortable modifying and improving spreadsheet products.



Please provide examples or evidence of previous results wherever possible.



Generic applications that do not answer these questions will not be considered.

Airbnb

Excellent at communicating with guests

title: Online Math/Science Teacher(Near-Native Accent)
description:
About Pomelo Academy

Pomelo Academy is an innovative online international school dedicated to delivering high-quality education to students worldwide. We provide a dynamic and engaging learning environment, catering to individualized instruction that transcends geographical boundaries.



Job Description

We are seeking passionate and experienced Near-Native English-speaking Online K-12 Math and/or Science Teachers with verifiable teaching certifications. The ideal candidates will have strong academic backgrounds in Mathematics and/or Science, experience teaching young learners (ages 5–18), and a commitment to creating a supportive, inquiry-based, and engaging online learning environment.



Responsibilities



Deliver interactive and engaging Math and/or Science lessons to individuals and small groups of 2–6 students aged 5–18.

Teach using internationally recognized curricula such as A Closer Look, Glencoe Science, Pearson Interactive Science, NGSS-aligned resources, Singapore Math, or IB/AP/A Level Math programs.

Create age-appropriate lesson plans focused on conceptual understanding, inquiry, problem-solving, and real-world applications.

Incorporate visuals, multimedia, and hands-on virtual activities to make abstract concepts accessible and engaging.

Monitor student progress and provide timely feedback to students and parents.

Foster curiosity, discussion, and active learning in a safe and supportive space.

Professional teacher with at least 2 years of teaching experience (Kindergarten–Grade 12).

Must hold a valid teaching license/certification (e.g., Teaching License, State Certification). TESOL/TEFL is a plus.

Near-native English accent with excellent spoken and written communication skills.

Strong academic background in Mathematics and/or Science (Biology, Physics, Chemistry, General Science).

Experience teaching in public/international schools or reputable online platforms.

Familiarity with inquiry-based and/or interdisciplinary approaches (e.g., STEM/STEAM).

Comfortable working between 07:00–22:00 (Weekdays) and 9:00–22:00 (Weekends), GMT+8.

Proficiency with digital platforms such as ClassIn, Microsoft Office, and other educational technologies.

Must have a stable and fast internet connection and a PC/laptop with at least Windows 10 or Mac OS Catalina.



Benefits



Flexible working hours.

Opportunity to teach using globally respected Math and Science curricula.

Be part of an international, passionate team of educators.

Access to training and professional development.

Regular enrollment model (not a booking system), ensuring schedule stability and consistency

OPERATIONS VA

💻 What You'll Be Responsible For

Responsibilities will include:



🔎 Product Research: Find potential winning products using your own research methods/search engines, as well as Base44 and other approved tools.

🛒 Product Sourcing: Research products from sources such as Walmart and Amazon and identify products with strong sales potential.

📊 Performance Awareness: Pay attention to which products are performing and use that information to improve future product research.

💬 Communication: Communicate promptly about problems, questions, delays, product issues, or anything that could affect the business.

🎓 Coaching & Training: Be open to feedback, coaching, new strategies, and learning our specific processes.

🎯 Monthly Expectations

250 quality eBay listings per month



Quality is just as important as quantity. Listings should be:



Accurate

Properly researched

SEO-friendly

Professionally presented

Priced appropriately

Up to date

Available for fulfillment

💰 Pay, Bonuses & Growth



We believe that when the business grows, the people helping build it should have the opportunity to grow as well.



Your starting compensation will be based on your experience and skill level.

📈 Performance-based pay increases

🎁 Sales performance bonuses

eBay dropshipping

eBay product listing

Walmart product research

Amazon product research

Finding products with sales potential

Managing and/or fulfilling eBay orders



We are not looking for someone who simply wants to learn eBay from scratch.



You should already understand the fundamentals of eBay dropshipping and be able to work independently while following our processes and standards.



🧠 The Right Personality Matters

Reliable and dependable

Organized and detail-oriented

Self-motivated

Comfortable working independently

Coachable and willing to learn

Honest and transparent

Goal-oriented

Proactive rather than reactive

Serious about building a long-term working relationship

🗣️ Communication Is NON-NEGOTIABLE



One of the most important qualities we are looking for is communication.



If you run into a problem, tell us.



If you're struggling with product research, tell us.



If you don't understand a task, ask questions.



If you notice an issue with a listing or order, communicate it immediately.



We do NOT expect you to know everything or never make a mistake. We do expect you to communicate when something isn't going according to plan.



We would much rather have a VA say, "I'm having trouble with this—can you help me?" than have an issue go unnoticed.



🤝 This Is More Than a Job



We are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of the team.

title: YouTube Editor & Uploader (Audio-First) for a New Sleep / Relaxation Channel: Shorts, Thumbnails, Scheduling
description:
HOURS: Flexible, about 10-15 hours a week to start. Reply to messages within 12 hours on weekdays and deliver on a fixed weekly schedule.



PAY: USD 200 per month to start. Raises are tied to the channel growing: as it earns, your pay goes up, and the right person can grow into a full-time role.



Looking for one reliable editor to run the whole post-production side of a brand-new faceless YouTube channel: guided relaxation, sleep and hypnosis-style audio (plus fun "can you resist" challenge files). 100% safe-for-work and family-friendly, no adult content ever. I write the scripts and record the voice. You take it from the raw WAV to a scheduled, promoted upload. Great fit if you love clean audio and want to grow with a channel from day one.



What you'll do for every file (about 2 files a week):



1. Audio editing. Take my raw voice recording (a WAV, recorded with a pro mic) and the script. Cut the mistakes (I snap or clap before re-reading a line, so they are easy to find). Remove mouth clicks and loud breaths but keep natural breathing. Remove background noise. Add a soft music bed and the sound effects the script calls for. Master to about -14 LUFS for YouTube. Export a final WAV and MP3.

2. Video. Build a simple video: a looping spiral or ambient visual (provided), a title card and chapter markers. No face, ever.

3. Thumbnail. Design the thumbnail from the text I give you, in our brand style.

4. Upload. Upload to YouTube with the title, description, chapters, tags and pinned comment I provide (you format them). Set it as unlisted for my approval, then schedule it.

5. Shorts. Cut 3 vertical Shorts from each file (30-60 seconds each, captions burned in).

6. Cross-posting. Post the Shorts to TikTok, Instagram Reels, X and Bluesky. Post the file to our website and add it to the weekly
.

7. Community. Reply to and moderate comments in the first hours after each upload, and remove spam.

8. Weekly report. Once a week, send views, watch time, new subscribers and the top comments in one short sheet.



You'll get a full written playbook, templates and checklists on day one.



MUST HAVE

- Real audio editing skill: Audacity, Adobe Audition, iZotope RX, Reaper, or similar. Tell me which one you use.

- Video editing: Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut desktop.

- Thumbnail design: Canva or Photoshop.

- YouTube Studio experience: uploading, scheduling, chapters, end screens.

- Good written English.

- A quiet ear: you must be able to hear clicks, hiss and bad cuts in soft, slow voice audio.

- Reliable internet and the ability to handle large audio files.

- Discretion. You never share files, scripts or channel details with anyone.



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with ASMR, meditation, sleep, podcast or audiobook channels.

- TikTok and Instagram Reels posting experience.

- WordPress basics.



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "QUIET EAR" so I know you read this. Then include:

1. Links to 2-3 audio or YouTube editing samples you made.

2. Which audio and video software you use.

3. Your weekly availability and your time zone.

4. Your expected monthly rate.

Shortlisted applicants get a paid test: a 3-minute raw voice file to clean up, master and turn into one Short. The test is paid whether or not you're hired.

title: Experienced Credit Repair Specialist – Advanced & Accelerated Dispute Methods
description:
# Experienced Credit Repair Specialist – Advanced & Accelerated Dispute Methods



## Summary



We are looking for an **experienced Credit Repair Specialist** who understands both traditional and advanced credit repair strategies.



We specifically want someone experienced with **faster, results-focused dispute methods**, including CFPB complaints when appropriate, direct-to-furnisher disputes, credit bureau disputes, verification challenges, identity-theft procedures when legitimately applicable, and strategic escalation of unresolved disputes.



This is **not an entry-level position**. We are looking for someone who can review a client's complete credit profile, identify the appropriate dispute strategy, and manage cases from initial analysis through resolution.



## Responsibilities



- Review Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion credit reports.

- Identify inaccurate, incomplete, duplicate, obsolete, or potentially unverifiable information.

- Develop an individualized dispute strategy for each client.

- Prepare and submit disputes with Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion.

- Prepare **CFPB complaints and escalations when appropriate**.

- Prepare direct disputes to creditors, collectors, and data furnishers.

- Handle debt-validation and verification-related correspondence when applicable.

- Understand how to respond to verified accounts and previous dispute results.

- Review bureau responses and determine the appropriate next dispute or escalation.

- Identify situations requiring additional documentation from the client.

- Understand legitimate identity-theft blocking procedures and documentation requirements.

- Track dispute deadlines, responses, deletions, corrections, and updates.

- Maintain detailed notes for every client and dispute round.

- Provide regular case updates to our internal team.

- Manage multiple client files simultaneously while maintaining accuracy.



## Advanced / Faster Credit Repair Experience



We are particularly interested in applicants who have hands-on experience with:



- CFPB complaint and escalation procedures

- Direct-to-furnisher disputes

- CRA online and mailed disputes

- FCRA-based dispute strategies

- FDCPA-related debt validation where applicable

- Method of Verification requests

- Reinvestigation procedures

- Identity-theft blocking procedures for legitimate identity-theft cases

- Mixed-file and inaccurate personal-information issues

- Duplicate account/reporting issues

- Collection and charge-off reporting disputes

- Late-payment reporting disputes

- Repossession reporting disputes

- Unauthorized hard-inquiry disputes

- Bankruptcy/public-record reporting issues

- Re-disputing previously verified information when there is a legitimate new basis or supporting evidence

- Escalating unresolved reporting errors through the appropriate channel



We want someone who understands that **every client's situation is different** and can determine which strategy is appropriate rather than sending the same generic dispute to every bureau or CFPB.



## Preferred Software Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



- Credit Repair Cloud

- DisputeFox

- Client Dispute Manager

- GoHighLevel

- IdentityIQ

- SmartCredit

- MyScoreIQ

- CFPB Consumer Complaint Portal

- Experian, Equifax, and TransUnion dispute systems



## Requirements



- Proven professional experience in credit repair.

- Strong understanding of U.S. consumer credit reporting.

- Strong working knowledge of the **FCRA and FDCPA** as they relate to credit reporting and disputes.

- Experience analyzing three-bureau credit reports.

- Experience preparing individualized dispute letters and complaints.

- Experience handling CFPB complaints.

- Ability to determine when a CFPB complaint, bureau dispute, direct furnisher dispute, or another legitimate escalation method is appropriate.

- Excellent written English and attention to detail.

- Strong organizational and case-management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple client files independently.

- Ability to document every action taken on a client's account.

- Commitment to using accurate client information and supporting documentation.



## Important



We are **not looking for someone who simply generates template dispute letters**.



We want an experienced specialist who understands how to analyze credit reports, investigate reporting issues, select the appropriate dispute method, interpret responses, and determine the next course of action.



All disputes must be based on the client's actual credit report, circumstances, and documentation. Applicants should **not use false identity-theft claims, fabricated documents, or knowingly false statements** to attempt to remove accurate information.



## How to Apply



Please submit your resume and briefly answer the following:



**1. How many years have you worked professionally in credit repair?**



**2. Which credit repair software have you used?**



**3. Explain your experience submitting CFPB complaints.**



**4. What faster or advanced dispute strategies have you successfully used?**



**5. How do you decide between a CRA dispute, direct furnisher dispute, CFPB complaint, or another escalation method?**



**6. What do you do when an account comes back verified after the first dispute?**



**7. Have you handled legitimate identity-theft cases? If yes, explain your process.**



**8. Approximately how many active client files can you manage at one time?**



**9. What is your desired hourly rate or monthly salary?**



## Paid Skills Test



Final candidates may be provided with a **redacted/sample three-bureau credit report**.



You will be asked to identify:



1. The items you would challenge.

2. The reason each item may be disputed.

3. The dispute method you would use.

4. Which items, if any, should be escalated.

5. The order in which you would perform the disputes.

6. What supporting documentation you would request from the client.



We are looking for someone who can explain **why** they selected each strategy—not simply generate dispute letters.

title: WordPress Business Directory Update with Local SEO (Project Based)
description:
About Us

We are the Busselton Chamber of Commerce and Industry (BCCI), a not-for-profit business organisation representing businesses across Busselton, Vasse, Dunsborough and Yallingup in the South West of Western Australia. Our website includes a business directory of our members, and we want every listing to be complete, accurate and easy to search.

The Project

We need an experienced VA to update approximately 180 business listings in our WordPress directory. The site is built with WordPress and Elementor. This is a one-off project with a clear finish line: every listing updated, consistent and optimised for local search.

What You Will Do

• Review and update each member listing using the business’s own website and Google Business Profile where available.

• Write or improve a clear, original business description for each listing (roughly 100  words), naturally including what the business does and where it operates, e.g. "electrician in Busselton".

• Keep the business name, address and phone number exactly consistent with the business’s other online listings.

• Assign the correct categories and tags so users can filter and browse the directory properly.

• Write an SEO title and meta description for each listing.

• Upload or replace logos and images, compress them for speed, and add descriptive alt text.

• Add website, social media and opening hours details where provided.

• Check that each listing displays correctly on desktop and mobile.

• Keep a simple tracking spreadsheet showing each listing, its status and any missing information we need to chase.

Must Have

• Proven experience editing WordPress sites, including Elementor.

• Experience with WordPress directory plugin Listeo.

• Solid understanding of on-page and local SEO: titles, meta descriptions, keywords, alt text and consistent business details.

• Excellent written English. Our audience is Australian, so Australian spelling is needed (e.g. "organisation", "optimise").

• Strong attention to detail and consistency across a large number of entries.

• Reliable internet and availability.



How We Will Work

• You will get your own WordPress login with the access level needed for this work. Please do not share logins or install plugins or themes without written approval.

• We will give you a style guide and 3 sample listings to complete first. Once approved, you will complete the rest.

• Progress check-ins every few days via
.

• All content you write becomes the property of BCCI. No AI-generated text may be published without being checked and edited for accuracy.

How to Apply

To show you have read this post, start your application with the words "Busselton Directory".

1. Tell us about a WordPress directory or listings project you have completed, with a link if possible.

2. Name the directory plugins and SEO plugins you have used.

3. Write a sample 100-word listing description for a fictional café in Dunsborough, including a meta title (under 60 characters) and meta description (under 160 characters).

4. Give your fixed price or hourly rate for approximately 180 listings, and your estimated timeframe.

Applications without the sample will not be considered.

title: Residential Framing Estimator (Remote, Ongoing) – US Custom Homes
description:
About us



Schondorf Enterprises, Inc. (SEI) is a design-build general contractor in Los Angeles. We build custom homes, and a large share of our current work is rebuilding homes lost in the Pacific Palisades fire. Our projects are high-performance, wood-framed and structurally detailed: hillside sites, heavy shear wall and hold-down requirements, and a lot of engineered lumber.



We're looking for an experienced framing estimator to produce accurate material takeoffs from our architectural and structural plans. This is an ongoing gig with room to grow as our project count increases.



What you'll do



Produce complete framing material takeoffs from architectural and structural plan sets, including:

dimensional lumber, plates and sill plates, studs and headers

floor and ceiling joists, rafters and blocking

engineered lumber (LVL, PSL, glulam, I-joists)

floor, wall and roof sheathing

Simpson Strong-Tie connectors, hold-downs, straps and anchors

nails, screws and other fasteners

Break takeoffs into ordering stages: foundation/sill, floor systems, walls, roof, and hardware.

Review takeoffs prepared by our lumber suppliers, and flag missing items or quantities that don't match the plans.

Read and apply shear wall, hold-down and nailing schedules and structural notes.

Flag discrepancies between architectural and structural drawings.

Help us refine and maintain our internal framing takeoff checklist.



Requirements



- 3+ years of framing or lumber takeoff experience on US residential projects. Please describe it specifically in your application.



- Strong knowledge of US light wood-frame construction and terminology.



- Experience reading structural plans, including shear wall and hold-down schedules.



- Proficiency in at least one takeoff tool: PlanSwift, Bluebeam Revu, On-Screen Takeoff, or similar.



- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.



- Clear written English, and the ability to ask questions when plans are unclear.



- Reliable internet and your own computer.



- Resourceful - with AI today, you can research and become more familiar and get answers



Nice to have



-  Experience with California projects, especially seismic hold-down and shear wall detailing.

-  Custom or high-end homes rather than production or tract housing.

- Background with a US lumberyard, truss manufacturer or framing contractor.

- Familiarity with Simpson Strong-Tie product lines.



Schedule and pay



Ongoing, project-based work. Takeoffs are assigned as new projects come in.



$50–$75 USD per completed takeoff, depending on scope, paid via Wise.



Flexible hours. Typical turnaround is TBDbusiness days per takeoff.

Ok to work on PH time

Consistent, accurate work will lead to more volume and expanded scope.



How to apply:
 - 



Please include:



A short description of your US residential framing takeoff experience: types of homes, which states, and who you did the work for.

The takeoff software you use.

A sample takeoff you've prepared, if you can share one (with client details removed is fine).

Answer this question: "When you see a hold-down specified on a structural plan, what items do you include in your takeoff for it?"

Start your application with the words "Custom Framing" so we know you read the full post.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid test takeoff ($50) before a final interview.

• Experience with, or the ability to recommend and implement, website integrations with HubSpot and LinkedIn.

• Strong written communication and reliable follow-through.

title: Fleet Repair Admin
description:
GH Logistics is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and reefer freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, equipment moving, and operations supported from pickup to delivery. If you’re someone who enjoys staying engaged, solving live challenges, and helping keep trucks and trailers operational, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You will support the operational backbone of the company by helping monitor fleet health, repair progress, preventive maintenance, internal team communication, and compliance tracking. This role is built for someone who can stay organized, follow up consistently, and help reduce downtime by making sure repair and maintenance issues are tracked, communicated, and completed properly.



If you thrive behind the scenes keeping equipment moving, coordinating updates, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks, this role is an excellent fit.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitoring truck and trailer maintenance, repair status, and service progress

• Tracking real time repair updates and following up with mechanics, dispatch, and internal teams

• Coordinating with mechanics, dispatch, and internal teams to prioritize urgent repairs

• Supporting preventive maintenance planning to help reduce breakdowns and downtime

• Updating maintenance trackers, dashboards, TMS, and internal systems with accurate repair notes and status updates

• Reviewing and tracking repair approvals, invoices, estimates, and billing updates

• Helping ensure DOT and FMCSA maintenance related compliance items are properly monitored

• Identifying repair delays, recurring equipment issues, and downtime risks early

• Escalating urgent maintenance concerns to the appropriate team members

• Maintaining clean documentation for repairs, maintenance history, internal team communication, and follow ups

• Following instructions consistently and executing with precision

• Staying team oriented, coachable, and open to feedback without ego



What Success Looks Like

• Fleet maintenance and repair trackers are consistently accurate and up to date

• Repair progress is monitored closely from start to completion

• Urgent equipment issues are escalated quickly and clearly

• Downtime risks are identified early and communicated properly

• Preventive maintenance items are followed up on before they become larger issues

• Mechanic, dispatch, and operations updates are organized and documented

• Repair approvals, invoices, and billing items are tracked cleanly

• Equipment status updates are communicated clearly, both verbally and in writing

• Shift handoffs are complete, accurate, and well documented



Who We’re Looking For

• Has experience in fleet maintenance, trucking operations, logistics, dispatch support, or administrative fleet operations

• Has basic mechanical knowledge or familiarity with trucks, trailers, repairs, and maintenance processes

• Understands the importance of equipment uptime, preventive maintenance, and fast repair follow up

• Highly organized and comfortable working with spreadsheets, dashboards, TMS, and maintenance tracking tools

• Able to monitor multiple repairs, trucks, trailers, and mechanics updates without losing accuracy

• Communicates clearly and professionally with mechanics, drivers, dispatch, and internal teams

• Pays strong attention to detail and uses sound judgment when issues arise

• Understands urgency and prioritization in a live logistics environment

• Familiar with DOT and FMCSA maintenance compliance requirements is a plus

• Follows instructions consistently and values clean processes

• Works well with a team and is open to feedback and coaching. Collaborates without resistance or ego

• Minimum of 50 words per minute



Why Join GH Logistics?

• Structured systems and clear expectations

• Hands on leadership and direct feedback

• Defined KPIs and measurable growth

• Opportunity to grow within a scaling freight brokerage and asset based logistics operation

Schedule & Work Setup

• Schedule: Dayshift 9 AM - 7 PM & Night shift Central Time (To be finalized during hiring)

• Zoom presence required

• Time tracking software used for accountability and performance support

This role is built for someone who genuinely enjoys keeping fleet operations organized, following repair progress, coordinating with mechanics, internal teams, and dispatch making sure trucks and trailers stay operational. If you like staying proactive, spotting risks before they become bigger problems, and helping reduce downtime behind the scenes, you’ll fit right in.

About the role



We’re looking for a highly capable, creative and results-driven Social Media VA to help grow our dog boarding business through social media.

We want someone who really understands social media, knows what makes people stop scrolling, and can turn content, engagement and followers into genuine enquiries and new customers.



You’ll be responsible for helping us build a strong online presence across platforms such as Instagram,
 and TikTok, with the ultimate goal of generating more awareness, enquiries and bookings.



What you’ll be doing



* Creating and managing engaging social media content

* Coming up with creative ideas for Reels, TikToks, Stories, posts and other content

* Writing engaging captions and calls-to-action

* Researching current social media trends and finding ways to adapt them for our business

* Creating content that showcases the dogs, our facilities, the experience we provide and what makes us different

* Increasing engagement and building a genuine local following

* Responding to comments and messages where appropriate

* Helping turn social media attention into actual enquiries and bookings

* Researching competitors and identifying opportunities to stand out

* Tracking what’s working and making recommendations based on results

* Developing ideas for promotions, campaigns and other ways to generate new business

* Potentially helping with basic paid social advertising as your experience develops



The person we’re looking for



We want someone who is genuinely good at social media, not someone who has simply completed a social media course.



You should:



* Have proven experience growing social media accounts

* Understand what makes short-form content perform

* Be creative and constantly coming up with new ideas

* Understand how to create content that generates customers, not just likes

* Have excellent written English

* Be comfortable editing videos and creating social graphics

* Understand Instagram,
 and TikTok

* Keep up with current trends

* Be proactive and able to work independently

* Be commercially minded and interested in the results behind the content

* Ideally have experience working with local businesses, hospitality, pets, leisure or similar businesses



Most importantly…



We want someone who can show us what they’ve achieved.



If you’ve grown an account, generated leads through social media, increased engagement significantly or helped a business generate revenue through social media, tell us about it and show us the numbers.



We’re much more interested in what you’ve actually achieved than a list of qualifications.



What success looks like



The aim of this role is ultimately to bring more customers through the door.



We’ll be looking at things such as:



* Growth in relevant local followers

* Reach and engagement

* Website/profile traffic

* Enquiries generated

* Leads generated from social media

* Which types of content generate the best results



We’re happy to give you creative freedom, but we want someone who is prepared to test, learn, analyse and improve, rather than simply posting the same type of content every week.

Instead, send us:



1. A brief introduction about yourself

2. Examples of social media accounts you’ve worked on

3. 2–3 examples of content you’re particularly proud of

4. Results you’ve achieved — include numbers wherever possible (followers, reach, engagement, leads, sales/bookings etc.)

6. Tell us which platforms you’re strongest on

7. Your hourly rate or preferred monthly fee

8. Your availability and how many hours per week you can commit



Bonus



As part of your application, we’d love you to give us 3 quick content ideas you think could help a dog boarding business attract more local customers.



This doesn’t need to be a full strategy — we simply want to see how you think.



Please put the words “DOG SOCIAL” at the beginning of your application so we know you’ve read the advert.



We’re looking for someone who can become a long-term part of the business and make a real commercial impact, so if you’re confident in your ability to grow a local business through social media, we’d love to hear from you.

title: # Technical Recruiter – Marine / Shipyard Trades
description:
REPOSTING TO FIND THE RIGHT CANDIDATE TO START ASAP! 



# Technical Recruiter – Marine / Shipyard Trades



**Part-Time | Remote | UK Company | Approx. 2 Days per Week Initially**



We are a UK-based company supplying skilled technical personnel for projects aboard **cruise ships, superyachts, commercial vessels and within shipyards/dry docks**.



We are looking for an experienced **Technical Recruiter** to join us on a part-time, remote basis. The successful candidate will initially work approximately **2 days per week**, with the potential for the role and hours to expand for the right person.



## The Role



Your primary responsibility will be to review, screen and shortlist skilled tradespeople for marine and shipyard projects, ensuring candidates have the appropriate technical experience, qualifications and certifications before being selected for testing and potential mobilization.



You will recruit across technical trades including:



* Welders / coded welders

* Pipefitters and fabricators

* Mechanical fitters / technicians

* Electricians

* Plumbers

* HVAC and related mechanical trades

* Other skilled marine and shipyard personnel



## Key Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



* Reviewing incoming CVs and applications

* Conducting initial candidate screening and telephone/video interviews

* Assessing candidates' technical experience and suitability for specific projects

* Reviewing welding qualifications, coding/certification and relevant trade credentials

* Understanding the difference between candidates suitable for shipyard/dry-dock work and those suitable for mobilisation aboard operational vessels

* Checking candidates' marine documentation and certification where required

* Identifying candidates who should progress to practical trade/welding testing

* Shortlisting and recommending suitable personnel to management

* Maintaining accurate candidate records and recruitment pipelines

* Communicating with candidates regarding documentation, testing, availability and potential mobilisation

* Helping develop and maintain a reliable pool of qualified technical personnel for future projects



## Technical Knowledge Required



NOTE This is **not a general recruitment or virtual assistant position**. We are specifically looking for someone who understands technical trades and can confidently assess whether a candidate's experience and qualifications are relevant.



You should have good working knowledge of several of the following areas:



**Welding & Fabrication**

Understanding of welding processes and terminology such as TIG/GTAW, MIG/MAG/GMAW, SMAW/MMA, FCAW, welding positions, materials and coded/qualified welders.



You should be comfortable reviewing welding qualifications and understanding whether a candidate's certification and experience are appropriate for the work being considered.



**Mechanical / Electrical / Plumbing**

Ability to understand CVs from mechanical fitters, pipefitters, electricians, plumbers and similar technical personnel and distinguish genuine relevant experience from general construction experience.



**Marine / Shipyard Recruitment**

Ideally, you will understand the documentation and certification that can be required when personnel work aboard vessels, cruise ships, yachts or within shipyards/dry docks.



Experience dealing with areas such as STCW certification, seafarer medicals, passports/visas, seaman's books and vessel-specific requirements would be highly advantageous.



You do not need to be a welder or engineer yourself, but you **must be technically confident enough to screen experienced tradespeople and ask the right questions**.



## Ideal Candidate



We would particularly like to hear from candidates who have previously worked in:



* Marine or maritime recruitment

* Shipyard recruitment

* Oil & gas / offshore recruitment

* Engineering recruitment

* Skilled trades recruitment

* Welding/fabrication recruitment

* Technical manpower or crewing agencies



Previous experience recruiting Filipino skilled tradespeople for international projects would be a significant advantage.



## Working Arrangement



* Fully remote position

* Working for a UK-based company

* Initially approximately **2 days per week**. Starting next month.

* Potential to increase hours/responsibilities for the right candidate

* Some availability during UK/US working hours will be required

* Hourly rate: Negotiable depending on experience**



We are more interested in finding someone with the **expert technical knowledge and recruitment experience** than simply selecting the lowest hourly rate.



## How to Apply



Please send your CV together with Linkedin page and a short introduction explaining your relevant recruitment experience.



In your application, please specifically answer the following:



1. What experience do you have recruiting welders, mechanical trades or other skilled technical personnel?

2. Have you recruited personnel for marine, shipyard, offshore or vessel-based work?

3. What welding qualifications/certifications are you familiar with?

4. What documentation or certification would you normally check before mobilising a tradesperson to work aboard a vessel?

5. Which technical trades are you most experienced in recruiting?

6. What hourly rate are you seeking?

7. Are you available approximately 2 days per week initially?



Applications that do not address these questions may not be considered.



We are looking for someone who can become a trusted part of our recruitment process and, for the right candidate, there is potential for the position to develop into a larger ongoing role.

title: Dedicated Premiere Pro Editor for Cruise Travel Channel
description:
About Us:

We run Port Lowdown, a fast-growing US-based digital media company. We help independent cruisers navigate global itineraries with zero friction. Having documented over 150 cruise ports, we are building a highly searchable video library that serves a passionate community of travelers. We operate with a culture of autonomy, extreme organization, and mutual respect. We are looking for a long-term team member to grow with us, starting part-time with a clear pathway to full-time.



The Role:

You will be working directly with our Post-Production Director, Troy. You will take over the assembly and initial cut phases of our flagship port guides.



This is not a gig where you have to organize a messy hard drive. You will receive a meticulously packaged Premiere Pro project file complete with proxies, color-coded pancake timelines, isolated audio tracks, pre-built stringouts, and a detailed voiceover transcript with director's notes. Your job is to take these organized ingredients and build compelling, fast-paced, high-retention travel episodes.



Key Responsibilities:



Build the "Hero" Hook: Craft dynamic, 60–90 second opening montages using our curated top 5% clips, archival "authority" footage, and standard MOGRT transition templates.



Navigate Pancake Timelines: Work from chronological stringouts utilizing our "Red Tag" chapter marker system on V2 to efficiently pull selects down to your master timeline.



Audio Balancing: Loosely edit the T1 narration track head-to-tail, mixing it with background music and preserving specific natural ambient sounds using J and L cuts and audio ducking.



Integrate Promos: Seamlessly drop in commercial assets (QR codes, PDF guide mockups) into mid-roll sections from dedicated project bins (e.g., 06_PROMOS_AND_CTAS).



Required Technical Mastery:



Premiere Pro Native: Highly proficient. (DaVinci Resolve familiarity is a bonus, but Premiere is our engine).



Proxy Workflow Expert: You must completely understand how to download a transfer folder, offline high-res media, attach local proxies, and work with the "Toggle Proxies" workflow to maintain our 4K (3840x2160) Rec. 2100 HLG / 29.97fps sequence settings.



File Management Discipline: You respect a rigid bin structure and understand why you only upload a newly versioned .prproj file back to our shared drive, rather than uploading massive media files.



VFR Handling: Knowledge of syncing and managing Variable Frame Rate screen recordings to avoid audio drift.



To Apply, You Must Follow These Exact Steps:



1. When you click apply, make the subject line of your message: 'Port Lowdown Editor: [Your Favorite Color]

2. Provide a link to ONE video you edited that best demonstrates your ability to hold viewer retention. Do not link a generic portfolio.

3. Write a brief paragraph explaining why you want to work on travel/cruise content specifically.

4. In one sentence, explain why working with proxies is crucial for a remote Premiere Pro workflow.



Note: Any application that does not follow these 4 steps perfectly will be immediately deleted without review.
salary: $350 USD per month for part time

title: Local SEO and PPC Specialist
description:
Department: Marketing 

Employment Type: Full-Time 

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–5:00 PM MST 

Compensation: $10–$13/hour, depending on experience



About the Role 



We are seeking an experienced Paid Media & Local SEO Specialist to manage and optimize digital marketing campaigns for multiple local service-based businesses. 



This role will focus heavily on Google Ads, local SEO, conversion tracking, attribution, and lead quality, while working closely with project managers, developers, and other marketing team members to ensure campaigns are properly tracked, optimized, and aligned with client goals. 



The ideal candidate is analytical, technically comfortable, proactive, and able to manage multiple accounts while identifying opportunities to improve campaign performance and lead quality. 



Key Responsibilities 



Google Ads & Paid Media 



Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns for local service-based businesses. 

Audit existing paid search campaigns and identify opportunities for improvement.

Conduct keyword research based on services, locations, customer intent, and competitors. 

Build and manage Search and Performance Max campaigns. 

Develop and test different keyword match types, ad variations, audiences, and campaign strategies. 

Continuously optimize keywords, negative keywords, bids, budgets, targeting, and ad performance. 

Monitor campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve lead volume and quality. 

Manage Meta Ads campaigns when needed. 



Conversion Tracking & Attribution 



Verify access and connectivity between advertising, analytics, call tracking, and website platforms. 

Set up and maintain conversion tracking through Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics. 

Work with developers when tracking codes, tags, forms, or website elements need to be implemented or corrected. 

Troubleshoot tracking issues and identify discrepancies between advertising platforms and lead-tracking systems. 

Monitor lead quality and conversion activity regularly. 

Identify tracking or attribution problems early and communicate them before they impact reporting or campaign decisions. 



Local SEO 



Conduct keyword research focused on local search intent and service-based businesses. 

Provide recommendations for on-page SEO improvements. 

Support the optimization and management of Google Business Profiles. 

Assist with GBP updates, services, posts, photos, and other local search activities. 

Monitor local search visibility and identify opportunities for improvement. 

Collaborate with content and SEO team members on keyword targeting, search intent, and website content. 

Support citation and directory management as needed. 



Conversion Rate Optimization 



Review landing pages, forms, and other conversion points to identify potential improvements. 

Ensure messaging between advertisements and landing pages is consistent. 

Identify opportunities to improve conversion rates and lead to quality. 

Collaborate with web developers to implement approved CRO recommendations. 

You will not be responsible for web development, but you should be comfortable working with websites and communicating technical requirements to developers. 



Reporting & Performance Analysis 



Analyze PPC, SEO, conversion, and attribution data across multiple client accounts. 

Prepare accurate performance data for internal reporting. 

Translate marketing data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations. 

Highlight account issues, performance changes, opportunities, and recommended next steps. 

Work closely with project managers to ensure account performance information is accurate and communicated on schedule. 

Maintain organized records of campaign changes, account activity, and important communications. 



Quality Assurance 



Review campaign and track data for accuracy. 

Monitor accounts for significant changes or performance issues. 

Identify low conversion rates, poor lead quality, tracking errors, budget concerns, and other potential issues. 

Proactively communicate concerns and recommended solutions to the appropriate team members. 

Help maintain consistent processes and documentation across accounts. 



Requirements 



Required 



Proven experience managing Google Ads for local service-based businesses. 

Agency experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously. 

Strong understanding of Google Search Ads and Performance Max. 

Hands-on experience with keyword research, negative keywords, campaign optimization, and budget management. 

Experience with conversion tracking and attribution systems. 

Working knowledge of Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics. 

Comfortable navigating a website backend and troubleshooting basic tracking implementations. 

Strong local SEO and keyword research experience. 

Understanding conversion rate optimization principles. 

Ability to analyze marketing data and turn it into practical recommendations. 

Strong written and verbal English communication skills. 

Highly organized and detail oriented. 

Proactive communicator who can work independently without constant supervision. 

Comfortable working in a fast-paced agency environment with multiple priorities and deadlines. 



Preferred, But Not Required 



Experience with Meta Ads or other paid advertising platforms. 

Experience working with call-tracking or lead-attribution platforms. 

Experience with fitness, wellness, home services, healthcare, or other local service industries. 

Experience managing Google Business Profiles. 

Experience with SEO platforms and local search tracking tools. 

Basic understanding of landing page optimization and lead-generation funnels. 

Interest or experience in the health and fitness industry. 



What We're Looking For 



We are looking for someone who doesn't simply manage campaigns based on a checklist. 

The right person will be able to look at an account, understand where leads are coming from, whether those leads are actually valuable, what is affecting conversion performance, and what should be tested or changed next. 

You should be comfortable asking questions, identifying problems before they become larger issues, and communicating recommendations clearly to both marketing and technical team members. 

You should also be comfortable working in an environment where processes are continually being improved and where team members are expected to contribute ideas rather than simply follow instructions. 



Core Skills 



Google Ads · Paid Search · Local SEO · Keyword Research · Google Analytics · Google Tag Manager · Conversion Tracking · Attribution · CRO · Google Business Profile · Lead Generation · Performance Analysis · Meta Ads 



Application 



Please submit your resume along with a brief overview of your experience managing Google Ads and local SEO for service-based businesses. 



Candidates may also be asked to complete a short skills assessment or account-analysis exercise as part of the hiring process.

Qualifications & Skills



Proven Talent: Minimum of 3-5 years of hands-on experience as an automotive upholsterer or interior trimmer, backed by a strong portfolio showcasing work on high-end, modern, or luxury vehicle interiors.

Mastery of Tools: Expert proficiency with industrial sewing machines, heat guns, cutting tools, foam shaping techniques, and specialized automotive adhesives.

Attention to Detail: An exceptional eye for detail, symmetry, and perfect material tensioning.

Technical Awareness: Foundational understanding of modern automotive electrical systems to safely manage interior electronic components during upholstery work.

Work Ethic: Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced, cutting-edge workshop environment while maintaining an immaculately clean and organized workspace.
