Hours

Night shift, 10pm to 6am Sydney time, 7 nights per week. Sydney moves to daylight saving in October, so your local shift times will shift by one hour between October and April.



The role

Our customers are travellers, and they often need help while Australia is asleep. Volume is low (typically 1 to 4 enquiries per shift) but response times are tight. You need to be at your desk and responsive for the full shift. When there are no enquiries, you'll work through site QA checks and content tasks.



Response time targets



Live chat: first response within 5 minutes

: first response within 10 minutes

Customer support



- Manage the Shopify Inbox (live chat) and the customer service
 inbox

- Keep saved replies up to date as common issues change



Site QA



- Check product and country pages for broken links, incorrect details, display issues and checkout problems

- Log anything found for the owner



Reporting



Send a short weekly summary: enquiry count, issue types, refunds and reissues, suspicious orders flagged, and any recurring problems



Requirements



- Hands-on experience using travel eSIMs yourself

- Previous customer service experience, ideally in e-commerce or telecommunications

- Working knowledge of Shopify admin (orders, customers, refunds, Shopify Inbox)

- Excellent written English with a warm, clear, concise tone

- Strong troubleshooting skills and good judgement on when to escalate

- Reliable internet, backup power or connection, and a quiet workspace for the full shift



Nice to have



Experience with Zoho Mail or similar inbox tools

Experience writing SEO blog or help centre content

Familiarity with roaming, network operators and 4G/5G coverage



Engagement



Paid trial period of 2 to 4 weeks

You'll receive a limited Shopify staff account , supplier portal login and customer service inbox
.

title: Junior Legal Associate / Legal Assistant

Application

We are looking for someone who wants to become exceptionally good at legal work—not someone who simply wants to complete assigned tasks.



Important: This position does not authorize the employee or contractor to independently practice U.S. law or provide U.S. legal advice. All substantive U.S. legal work is performed under attorney supervision and direction.

title: Prospecting and Closing Software Sales
description:
Outbound Sales Closer – Auto Repair Shop Software (US Market)



About us



We are an authorized reseller of Mitchell 1 software for independent auto repair shops in the United States. Mitchell 1 is used by thousands of US shops for repair information (ProDemand), shop management and estimating (Manager SE), and customer follow-up and marketing (SocialCRM). We help shop owners choose the right products, get set up and get value from them.



The role



You will call independent auto repair shops in the US, book and run product demos, and close sales. After the sale you will help new customers get started, train their service writers and technicians on the basics, and handle first-line software questions. You will work closely with a small team, share what is working, and keep our CRM up to date.



This is a closing role. We are looking for someone who has personally closed sales, not only booked appointments for someone else.



What you will do



- Make outbound calls to US auto repair shop owners and managers.  

- Qualify each shop and book demos.  

- Run screen-share demos built around a shop's day: looking up a repair, writing an estimate, following up with the customer.  

- Handle objections and ask for the sale.  

- Onboard new customers and train their staff on first steps.  

- Answer first-line support questions (logins, setup, "where do I find…") and escalate to Mitchell 1 support when needed.  

- Log every call and deal in the CRM.



What we are looking for



Required



- A track record of closing sales yourself, with numbers you can share: deals closed, deal sizes, close rate. Proof such as a commission statement, CRM screenshot or reference is a strong plus.  

- Experience cold calling US businesses, with daily call volumes you can describe.  

- Clear, confident spoken English suited to busy US small-business owners.  

- A quiet work space with minimal background noise and a noise-cancelling headset.  



- Availability for a set schedule within US Pacific business hours.



**Nice to have**



- Software or subscription (SaaS) sales experience.  

- Automotive, parts or repair shop experience.  

- Technical support or customer training experience.  

- Experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce

- Spanish.

- Reliable internet and electricity, with a backup internet connection on a different network and backup power (UPS, generator or power station).  



Our hiring process



1. Apply with the items listed below.  

2. Short follow-up questions and a voice recording (a few minutes of your time).  



How to apply



Please include all of the following. Applications missing these items will not be reviewed.



1. Start your application with the words "**Repair Shop Closer**" so we know you read this post.  

2. Describe the last sale you closed yourself: what you sold, who the customer was, the price and how you got the yes.  

3. Your best month in sales: how many deals you closed and what they were worth.  

4. A 60-second voice recording (a link is fine) of a cold call to the owner of a 4-bay auto repair shop, then your response to: "It's too expensive, I'll think about it." One take, no editing, on the headset you use for work.  

5. The city where you will work, a screenshot of a recent internet speed test, and a short description of your backup internet and backup power.  

6. The hours you can work in US Pacific time.  

7. Your resume/CV



We read every application. Thank you for your time.

title: Real Estate Phone Specialist – Excellent Spoken English Required
description:
Real Estate Phone Specialist – Excellent Spoken English Required (Part-Time, $7/hr + Bonuses)



About us



We are a small, locally owned real estate company in Oklahoma, USA. We are not a call center. You will work directly with the owners as part of a small team, and you will be known by name and treated as a real team member.



The role



This is a phone role, and you will be the voice of our company. Your job is to make outbound calls to:



- **Buyers:** Call investors and potential buyers to tell them about our available properties and find out what they are looking for.

- **Sellers (acquisitions):** Call homeowners to see if they are interested in selling, have a friendly conversation, and gather basic details about the property.



You will also log notes from each call in our CRM and pass interested leads to the owners.



**What matters most: your spoken English**



This is our top priority. Most applicants will not qualify on this point, so please be honest with yourself before applying.



- Your spoken English must be excellent: fluent, clear, and natural.

- You need a neutral, American-sounding accent that US homeowners and investors understand easily on the first try.

- You must be comfortable in unscripted conversation, not only reading a script.

- You should sound warm, confident, and professional on the phone.



**Other requirements**



- Previous outbound calling experience (real estate experience is a plus, but not required)

- A quiet, dedicated workspace with no background noise

- A reliable computer and a noise-canceling headset

- Fast, stable internet, with a backup connection preferred

- Available during US Central Time business hours

- Reliable, honest, and comfortable hearing "no" on the phone



**Pay and hours**



- $7 USD per hour to start

- Bonuses for closed deals

- Part-time to start: 20 hours per week

- Opportunity to move to full-time for the right person



**How to apply**



Applications missing any of the items below will not be reviewed.



1. **Video recording (1–2 minutes).** Record yourself speaking as if you are on a phone call. Introduce yourself, then say the following in your own natural style: *"Hi, this is [your name] with a local home buying company. I'm calling about your property. We buy houses in the area, and I wanted to see if you'd be open to an offer. Do you have a quick minute?"* Then spend 30 seconds telling us why you are good on the phone.

2. **Photo of your desk setup,** showing your computer, headset, and workspace.

3. **Screenshot of your internet speed test** from speedtest.net, showing download speed, upload speed, and ping.

4. **A short note** on your calling experience.



Start your application with the words "Voice of the Company" so we know you read the full posting.

title: AI Architect
description:
AI Architect / Senior AI Automation Engineer

Build and Manage Multiple AI Agents on Local Hardware — Remote



Work arrangement: Fully remote is welcome.  

Scope:  Architecture, hands-on development, deployment, integration, and ongoing improvement of multiple AI agents.  

Compensation: Based on experience, demonstrated technical ability, and agreed scope.



 About the Role



We are seeking a hands-on AI Architect / Senior AI Automation Engineer to design, build, deploy, and maintain multiple AI agents on our existing local AI machines.



Our goal is to develop a growing collection of agents that reduce repetitive work, improve efficiency, and optimize workflows across customer communications, marketing, inventory, administration, and other business operations.



This is not a single-chatbot project. You will establish the underlying infrastructure and create multiple specialized agents that can work independently, integrate with our business systems, and coordinate when appropriate.



We are looking for someone who can personally implement and troubleshoot the systems—not only provide recommendations, write prompts, or configure demonstrations.



Agents You Will Build



The initial scope includes the following, with additional agents developed as we identify and prioritize workflow opportunities:



| Agent type | Expected responsibilities |



| AI receptionist | Answer incoming calls, respond to approved questions, capture information, assist with scheduling, route calls, create follow-up tasks, and transfer conversations to a human when necessary. |

| SEO agents | Support keyword research, website audits, content planning, on-page optimization, performance reporting, and identification of opportunities to improve search visibility. Website changes and publication must follow defined approval rules. |

| Social media management agents | Plan content calendars, draft posts and responses, coordinate approved publishing, monitor engagement, and produce performance summaries. |

| Inventory management agents | Monitor inventory records, track usage, identify discrepancies, flag low stock, forecast replenishment needs, and prepare reorder recommendations or approved purchasing workflows. |

| Data entry agents | Extract, validate, organize, and enter information from documents,
s, forms, and spreadsheets into approved systems, with duplicate detection and human review for uncertain information. |

| Additional workflow agents | Automate reporting, document processing, internal knowledge searches, task coordination, reminders, customer follow-up, and other repetitive operational processes. |



The work will be delivered in prioritized phases. You should be able to identify where an AI agent adds value and where a simpler, rules-based automation is more appropriate.



Mandatory Requirement: Local Hosting



All agents must be hosted on our company-owned local AI machines—not on a contractor’s computer or a cloud-hosted agent platform.



The architecture must support local model inference, agent execution, workflow orchestration, and the agents’ supporting data stores. For voice applications, the proposed design should include locally hosted speech processing.



Approved integrations may still connect to telephone carriers, websites, social media platforms,
, calendars, and other business systems. These external services are integration endpoints, not substitutes for hosting the agents and their AI processing locally.



All external dependencies and data transfers must be disclosed and approved. Undisclosed cloud-model calls or automatic cloud-model fallback are not acceptable.



 Key Responsibilities



Assess the hardware and design the architecture. Review our existing machines, identify capabilities and limitations, recommend suitable models and software, and plan how multiple agents will share resources. Measure performance and identify any hardware upgrades needed before expanding the system.



Build and integrate the agents. Develop the application logic, tools, knowledge retrieval, workflows, and connections to our business software. Establish reusable components so new agents can be added without rebuilding the entire system.



Make the systems reliable and manageable. Implement testing, monitoring, error reporting, retries, recovery procedures, and safeguards against duplicate or incorrectly completed actions. Provide a practical way for us to view agent activity, review exceptions, and pause or disable individual agents.



Protect access and data. Use secure remote access, appropriately limited permissions, protected credentials, and activity logs. Build approval checkpoints for actions such as publishing content, placing orders, changing important records, or sending sensitive communications.



Document, hand over, and improve the system. Maintain source code, configuration, deployment instructions, backups, and operating documentation in accounts we control. Train users, troubleshoot issues, and improve the agents based on measured results and business feedback.



Required Experience



- Demonstrated local AI deployment experience. You have personally deployed and operated language models and agents on physical hardware and can explain hardware requirements, memory usage, model selection, and performance tradeoffs.

- Strong software engineering skills. You can write, debug, test, and maintain custom application code, preferably in Python, with JavaScript or TypeScript experience where relevant.

- Agent and integration development. You have experience with tool-using agents, APIs, webhooks, authentication, databases, structured outputs, and document-based knowledge retrieval.

- Deployment and operations. You are comfortable with containers, service configuration, networking, monitoring, backups, and remotely maintaining locally hosted systems.

- Testing and security. You can demonstrate failure handling, access controls, output validation, and human approval mechanisms—not just successful demonstrations.

- Clear communication and ownership. You can translate business needs into technical requirements, explain tradeoffs, document your work, and independently move projects through implementation.



Experience limited to prompts, basic chatbot setup, or connecting cloud services through no-code tools is not sufficient by itself. Automation platforms are welcome where appropriate, but you must be able to develop and maintain custom code.



Particularly Relevant Experience



Experience with real-time voice agents, locally hosted speech recognition and speech generation, SEO and social media integrations, inventory systems, document extraction, and business-process automation will be valuable.



Experience with dental or healthcare workflows, practice-management software, and systems handling sensitive information is also a plus.



Expected Deliverables



The engagement should begin with a hardware assessment, proposed architecture, and prioritized development roadmap. From there, you will deliver a working pilot agent on our local hardware before expanding into additional agents.



Each completed agent must include its source code, deployment configuration, integration documentation, test results, operating instructions, and clearly documented limitations. The overall system should include monitoring, recovery procedures, and a maintainable structure for adding future agents.



Success will be measured by reliable task completion, accuracy, response times, reduced manual work, and ease of maintenance—not simply the number of agents created.



How to Apply



Please include:



1. Two or three relevant projects you personally built, explaining what each agent did, your individual contribution, and whether it was used in production.

2. Details of your local deployments: hardware specifications, models used, deployment approach, and any external services the system depended on.

3. Supporting evidence: a portfolio, code samples, recorded walkthrough, or a live demonstration that you are authorized to share.

4. Your proposed approach: how you would assess our machines, deploy the first agent, and support multiple agents over time.

5. Your availability, time zone, preferred working arrangement, and hourly or monthly compensation expectations.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a paid technical pilot in a restricted test environment before a broader engagement.



We are looking for someone who can take ownership of building a dependable, locally hosted AI system and continue developing agents that meaningfully improve how our business operates.

title: Senior Accounts Receivable & Bookkeeping Specialist
description:
Senior Accounts Receivable & Bookkeeping Specialist



**Remote  

**Full-Time | U.S. Eastern Time Hours**



Eagle Production Co., a U.S.-based professional equipment rental and live-event production company, is looking for an experienced **Senior Accounts Receivable & Bookkeeping Specialist** to join our team remotely from the Philippines.



We are looking for a **high-level, experienced accounting professional** who can take real ownership of accounts receivable, payment application, collections, reconciliations, and day-to-day bookkeeping.



This is not an entry-level bookkeeping role.



## What You’ll Do



- Manage accounts receivable and monitor outstanding customer balances.

- Apply incoming ACH, wire, check, and credit card payments accurately.

- Match payments to invoices and resolve unapplied or unidentified payments.

- Perform customer account reconciliations.

- Proactively follow up on past-due invoices and manage collections.

- Communicate professionally with customers regarding outstanding balances.

- Maintain detailed collection notes and follow-up schedules.

- Communicate internally when payments are received or when customer accounts require attention.

- Work closely with our sales, operations, and management teams.

- Assist with bank and credit card reconciliations.

- Maintain accurate records in **QuickBooks**.

- Assist with general bookkeeping, reporting, and accounting support as needed.

- Identify discrepancies or accounting issues and take ownership of getting them resolved.



## What We’re Looking For



- Multiple years of professional accounting, AR, or bookkeeping experience.

- **Previous experience working remotely for a U.S.-based company is strongly preferred.**

- Advanced working knowledge of **QuickBooks**.

- Strong accounts receivable and collections experience.

- Experience managing a large number of customer invoices and open balances.

- Strong understanding of payment application and account reconciliation.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

- Confident communicating directly with U.S. customers regarding collections.

- Highly organized and able to manage follow-ups without constant supervision.

- Strong judgment and ability to recognize when an issue needs to be escalated.

- Team-oriented and proactive about communicating payment and account updates internally.



## Collections Experience



We are specifically looking for someone who already understands how to run an effective collections process.



You should have your own organized approach for:



- Aging reports

- Follow-up schedules

-
 and phone collections

- Tracking customer promises to pay

- Escalating seriously overdue accounts

- Maintaining collection notes

- Prioritizing accounts by age, balance, and urgency



We do not want to teach someone the basics of collections from scratch. We want someone who can bring experience and structure to the role.



## Working Hours



This position follows **U.S. Eastern Time business hours, approximately 8:00 AM–5:00 PM ET, Monday through Friday.**



For someone in the Philippines, this is an **overnight position**, generally approximately **8:00 PM–5:00 AM PHT while the U.S. is on daylight saving time and 9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT during standard time.**



Candidates must be comfortable consistently working this schedule.



## Technology & Home Office Requirements



Because this is a fully remote role, candidates must have:



- Reliable high-speed internet

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career

title: Business Operations & Strategy Manager — Remote
description:
Business Operations & Strategy Manager

Remote | Full-Time | Australian Healthcare Group



We are looking for a highly capable, resourceful and independent Business Operations & Strategy Manager to help manage and improve the day-to-day operations of a growing Australian healthcare group.



This is not a role for someone who waits for instructions.



We need someone who can be given a problem, an idea, or even a vague question and independently figure out what needs to happen next.



You will work closely with senior management and coordinate across operations, customer/patient support, developers, websites, CRM/email systems, marketing, automation and other backend functions.



What You'll Be Doing



Business Operations

- Help oversee day-to-day business operations across multiple healthcare services.

- Identify operational problems, bottlenecks and inefficiencies.

- Develop and improve workflows, processes and SOPs.

- Monitor projects and ensure tasks are completed properly and on time.

- Coordinate between different teams and external contractors.

- Help management turn ideas into executable plans.



Research & Problem Solving

You will regularly receive questions such as:

- "Can we do this?"

-"How would we make this work?"

-"Is there a better system for this?"

-"Research this and tell me our options."



We expect you to independently:

- Research unfamiliar topics.

- Understand the problem.

- Identify possible solutions.

- Compare options.

- Consider cost, operational impact and risks.

- Recommend the best practical approach.

- Help implement the chosen solution.



You do not need to know everything. You need to know how to figure things out.



Technology & Backend Coordination

You will help coordinate projects involving:

- Websites

- Developers

- CRM systems

-
 systems and campaigns

- Business software

- Integrations

- Automations

- Online forms and patient/customer journeys

- Internal systems and databases



You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable with technology and capable of communicating requirements to technical teams.



Marketing & Digital Operations

You may also coordinate:

- Digital marketing projects

- Website improvements

-
 campaigns

- Social media/marketing contractors

- Landing pages

- Customer/patient communication

- Agencies and external providers



You don't necessarily need to personally execute every task. Your job is to **understand what needs to happen, find the right solution or person, and make sure it gets done.**



We're looking for someone who is:

- Highly intelligent and resourceful.

- An excellent problem solver.

- Comfortable making decisions independently.

- Naturally curious and good at research.

- Able to learn unfamiliar subjects quickly.

- Organised and capable of managing multiple projects simultaneously.

- Comfortable working with senior management.

- Confident challenging an existing process when there is a better way.

- Able to think strategically while still being hands-on.

- Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change.

- Strong in written and spoken English.

- Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new platforms.

- Detail-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture.



Most importantly, we want someone who **thinks like an owner, not just an employee completing a task list.**



The Type of Person Who Will Succeed Here

If you encounter something you've never done before, your first response should be:

**"Let me figure it out."**



You should be comfortable searching, researching, testing systems, speaking with vendors, comparing solutions and asking intelligent questions.



When you identify a problem, we don't want you to simply report:

**"There's a problem."**



We want:

**"Here's the problem, here's why it's happening, here are our options, and here's what I recommend we do."**



We also value people who proactively say:

**"I've noticed we're doing this manually. I think there's a better way."**



That mindset is extremely important for this position.



Experience

We care more about **capability, judgement and initiative** than a specific degree.



Experience in any of the following would be advantageous:

- Business operations

- Project management

- Healthcare operations

- Australian businesses

- BPO / outsourcing

- Startups or rapidly growing businesses

- SaaS or technology companies

- CRM / automation

- Digital marketing

- Website management

- Managing developers or technical teams



Experience working with Australian companies is highly desirable.



## What This Role Is NOT

This is not:

title: PM Scheduler & Customer Retention Specialist
description:
We are looking for a PM Scheduler & Customer Retention Specialist to own our preventive maintenance pipeline and keep our technicians’ calendars full. This is a production scheduling role with real sales responsibility: you will prospect new PM customers, send and follow up on PM proposals until they sign, schedule all PM and warranty work, and keep existing PM accounts happy.



You will work closely with our Customer Service Admin, who handles the main phone line, collections, repair invoices, and simple bookings when parts are already onsite. You take everything they hand off — PM leads, warranty jobs, and repairs that need parts ordered — and you own the calendar from there.



This is not a generic receptionist job. Success here means a full tech calendar (~1 week booked ahead), PM contracts signed, and PM customers retained.



What you will do every day

PM sales & retention



Identify and pursue new PM prospects: gyms, hotels, HOAs, property managers, and commercial facilities

Work warm leads handed off from Customer Service (PM LEAD packets)

Send PM contract proposals via email and follow up persistently until the customer signs or clearly declines (target: touch every open quote at least every 5 business days)

Proactive outreach to existing PM accounts — resolve issues before contracts churn

Scheduling & calendar management



Schedule all preventive maintenance visits for signed PM contracts (commercial + residential)

Keep technicians booked ~1 week ahead — never let the calendar drop below ~3 business days of work unless intentionally left open

Schedule warranty jobs within each manufacturer’s expected timeline

Schedule parts repair jobs when parts are ordered, in transit, or marked ready in Trello (Parts Admin workflow)

Process HANDOFF packets from Customer Service — book in ServiceMinder same day (urgent) or within 24 hours (routine)

Daily workflow



Review open PM proposals due for follow-up today

Check ServiceMinder calendar density per technician

Monitor Trello Parts Admin for Phase 5 overdue cards and parts-ready jobs

Work PM compliance list for overdue commercial PM visits

Process warranty queue

Return PM retention calls/messages from the prior day

What this role is NOT

Not the primary answer on the main customer service phone line (Customer Service Admin owns that)

Not responsible for unpaid invoice follow-up or sending repair invoices

Not responsible for repair/diagnostic proposals (those are Customer Service)

Not booking simple diagnostic/repair visits when parts are already at the customer’s site (Customer Service books those)

Clear handoffs between the two roles are documented — you will know exactly what is yours vs. what gets handed off.



Tools you will use

ServiceMinder (primary — scheduling, PM proposals, customer records)

Google Sheets (PM schedule planning calendar)

Trello (Parts Admin cards, commercial PM funnel)

Gmail (PM proposals and scheduling confirmations)

RingCentral (PM prospect and retention calls — backup on main line when needed)

WhatsApp (scheduler/tech coordination)

Warranty manufacturer portals (training provided)



How we measure success

Weekly performance review with the owner. Metrics are tracked — this role has clear accountability.



Ideal candidate

Calendar thinker — you naturally plan ahead and hate empty technician days

Comfortable with outbound sales — PM prospecting and polite persistence on proposals without being pushy

Field service or commercial PM experience a strong plus — gyms, hotels, property management, HVAC-style recurring service

Professional phone and email communication

Job Description

Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Transport Operations Officer

Job Type: Remote / Part-Time 

Job Hours: ~20 Hours Per Week

Reports to: Operations Manager

Direct Reports: Transport Operations Support

Start Date: June 2026



About Priority Haulage

Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary

Priority Haulage is seeking a capable, high-capacity, and dependable Transport Operations Officer to support day-to-day operations within a fast-paced, high-accountability environment.



The role reports primarily to the Operations Manager and works closely with the Financial Controller on systems, process improvement, and operational coordination initiatives.



This position is central to maintaining operational continuity across fleet dispatch, driver management, compliance coordination, and transport administration within a structured, performance-driven business focused on operational efficiency, accountability, and scalable systems.



Role Overview

This role is suited to an operations professional who can consistently deliver reliable outcomes with minimal supervision in a deadline-driven environment. Performance will be assessed based on operational consistency, responsiveness, task completion, communication quality, and ability to maintain established workflows and standards.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent coverage aligned with New Zealand business operations, including early morning dispatch coordination and operational responsiveness throughout the day.



Core Operational Coverage (PHT)

5:00 AM – 1:00 PM: Primary operational window covering fleet dispatch, job loading, driver coordination, and daily operational tasks.



2:00 PM – 5:00 PM: Flexible operational coverage period supporting job closing activities, operational follow-up, and preparation/loading for the following operational cycle as required.



The role is workflow and task-driven, with hours and workload fluctuating depending on job volume, fleet activity, and operational requirements. Compensation is based on actual hours worked.



Final working arrangements and compensation structure will be discussed and agreed with the successful candidate based on operational requirements, workflow demands, and demonstrated capability within the role. The position is expected to require approximately ~20 - 25 hours per week, with baseline workload increasing as operational responsibilities expand.



Job Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities



Fleet Dispatch

• Job Processing

• Job Quality Control



Fleet Management

• Fleet Maintenance Coordination

• EROAD Management

• Fuel Management



Driver Management

• Logbook Compliance

• Leave Management

• Uniform Inventory Management

• Driver Records Management

• Performance Management Support



Operational Support & Administration

• Support cross-functional operational workflows.

• Maintain accurate operational records and documentation.

• Assist with operational coordination and process improvement.

• Support internal communication, task coordination, and workflow follow-up.

• Assist leadership with operational reporting and action tracking where required.



Progressive Responsibilities

The successful candidate will progressively support and coordinate additional operational safety and compliance functions as part of the wider operations role, including:



• Compliance & Risk Support

• Insurance Claims Coordination

• Health & Safety Administration



Required Experience & Capability

Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating within a structured, deadline-driven transport or logistics environment:

• Minimum 6+ years’ hands-on experience managing high-volume transport dispatch, fleet coordination, and operational workflows.

• Proven experience within transport, logistics, dispatch, or fleet operations environments.

• Strong organisational and commercial judgement, with the ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously.

• Demonstrated experience using Transport Management Systems (TMS), fleet management platforms, dispatch systems, or operational workflow software.

• Ability to operate independently within a remote work environment

• Effective problem-solving capability and operational judgement.

• Intermediate Microsoft Excel capability, including, filtering, sorting, and pivot tables

• A high level of technical proficiency across the Microsoft platform and modern operational business systems, with working familiarity in tools such as:

o Notion

o ChatGPT



Preferred Experience 

• Exposure to New Zealand or Australian transport and logistics environments.

• Exposure to health & safety, driver compliance, and quality control processes.

• Demonstrated ability to improve operational workflows through process optimisation, system improvement, or automation initiatives.

• Exposure to coordinating, supporting, or overseeing operational staff within a structured operations environment.



Personal Attributes

• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to contribute effectively.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, dependable, and accountable, with strong follow-through and responsiveness.

• Able to remain calm and organised within a fast-paced operational environment.

• Strong ownership mindset with consistent follow-through and responsiveness.



Required Equipment and Setup

• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer Requirements (Desktop PC or Laptop):

o Processor: Intel Core i5 or better.

o RAM: Minimum 8GB (16GB preferred).

o Operating System: Windows 10/11, compatible with required business software.

description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~15 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (typically 15-20 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location: Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: August



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. 



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours (NZT)

9:30 AM – 12:00 PM NZT (5:30 AM – 8:00 AM PHT)

These hours are required each business day and cover core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Monday only), and communication with the New Zealand team.



The operational finance workload during this period is expected to be manageable within these core hours under normal operating conditions.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately 15–20 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

• Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.

title: Lead Generation & Sales Support
description:
About Expose Me Marketing



Expose Me Marketing is a Sydney-based full-service marketing agency helping businesses grow through branding, websites, SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social media, content and digital strategy.

We’re looking for a proactive and confident Lead Generation & Sales Support Virtual Assistant to support our sales and operations team.



This is not a hard-selling or cold-calling role. Your primary responsibility will be identifying quality potential clients, researching their businesses, initiating personalized outreach and creating warm opportunities for our Sales & Operations team to follow up and close.



Key Responsibilities



- Research and identify businesses that fit our ideal client profiles

- Source leads through Google, Google Maps, LinkedIn, Meta Ad Library, business directories and other relevant platforms

- Identify business owners and key decision-makers

- Research each prospect before contacting them and identify genuine marketing opportunities

- Review websites, Google presence, social media, advertising and overall digital presence for obvious opportunities

- Send personalized introductory
s, LinkedIn messages and other outreach

- Manage follow-up sequences for prospects who haven't responded

- Re-engage previous EMM enquiries, old proposals and past clients

- Identify potential additional services for existing EMM clients

- Qualify interested prospects before handing them over to our Sales & Operations team

- Book qualified prospects into sales meetings

- Maintain accurate lead information and notes in our CRM

- Track all outreach, responses, follow-ups and appointments

- Provide a clear handover to the salesperson before each appointment

- Research potential referral and strategic partnership opportunities

- Assist with general sales administration when required



What We're Looking For



We're looking for someone who is resourceful and takes initiative.



You shouldn't need to be given a list of businesses every morning. We want someone who can understand the type of client we're looking for, research the market and find opportunities independently.



You should have:

- Previous experience in lead generation, prospecting, sales support or virtual assistance

- Strong online research skills

- Excellent written English

- Confidence communicating professionally with Australian businesses

- Experience finding business owners and decision-makers

- Strong attention to detail

- Excellent organization and follow-up skills

- Ability to personalize outreach rather than send generic messages

- Confidence using spreadsheets, CRMs and online business tools

- Ability to work independently and manage daily targets

- A positive attitude and willingness to learn

Digital marketing or agency experience is highly preferred.

Experience with LinkedIn prospecting, Google Maps research, Meta Ad Library, CRM systems,
 outreach or lead-generation platforms would also be advantageous.



What Success Looks Like



This role isn't about sending as many messages as possible.

We care about quality opportunities.

Your performance will be measured through the quality of leads researched, personalized outreach completed, follow-ups completed, positive responses generated, qualified appointments booked and ultimately the opportunities generated for the business.

Important

We are not looking for someone who simply copies business names into a spreadsheet or sends hundreds of generic messages.

Before contacting a prospect, you should be able to answer:

Why would this particular business potentially need Expose Me Marketing?

You might notice they have an outdated website, poor Google visibility, inconsistent branding, weak social media, are actively advertising but have a poor landing page, have recently opened or expanded, or have another clear marketing opportunity.

Your job is to find the opportunity, start the conversation and warm the lead.

Our Sales & Operations team will take over once a prospect demonstrates genuine interest.



How to Apply



Please include:

- A brief introduction about yourself

- Your previous lead generation or sales support experience

- The tools/platforms you've used for prospecting

- An example of how you would find potential clients for a marketing agency

- An example of a cold outreach message you would send to a potential client

Please do not send a generic application. We want to see how you think and research.

title: ROBLOX Video Game Item Delivery & Catalogue Specialist
description:
Video Game Item Delivery & Catalogue Specialist — Roblox Games



Remote Position



We’re looking for an experienced Roblox player to fulfil customer orders and maintain our catalogue of in-game items, pets, and currencies. This role combines item delivery, inventory management, product research, and customer support.



You should understand trading and delivery mechanics in **Pet Simulator 99, Murder Mystery 2, Creatures of Sonaria, Fisch, and Blox Fruits**.



### Schedule & Compensation



- **Pay:** USD $340 per month.

- **Schedule:** Five days per week, 12-hour shifts with breaks.

- **Days off:** Two days per week.

- You must be available consistently for your assigned shift.



### Responsibilities



- Deliver customer orders using each game’s appropriate trading or delivery system.

- Verify usernames, item variants, quantities, and order details before delivery.

- Communicate with customers and resolve routine delivery issues.

- Keep accurate delivery records and supporting screenshots.

- Track inventory across company accounts and report stock shortages.

- Create and update listings with accurate product names, descriptions, images, variants, and quantities.

- Research item values, availability, competitor pricing, and customer demand.

- Follow game updates and recommend new products.

- Coordinate pending orders and inventory information during shift handovers.



### Requirements



- Hands-on Roblox trading experience and strong knowledge of the games listed above.

- Good written English and professional customer communication.

- Strong attention to detail when handling customer orders and valuable items.

- A reliable computer and internet connection capable of running Roblox smoothly.

- Comfort using spreadsheets, product dashboards, and multiple game accounts.

- Ability to follow procedures, work independently, and maintain a consistent schedule.



### Application Questions — Please Answer Every Question



**Experience & Availability**



1. Which of these games have you personally played and traded in: Pet Simulator 99, Murder Mystery 2, Creatures of Sonaria, Fisch, and Blox Fruits? Describe your experience in each, including how recently you played.

2. Have you previously delivered digital items, managed inventory, maintained product listings, or provided customer support? Give specific examples.

3. Have you reviewed and accepted the compensation of **USD $340 per month**?

4. Can you consistently work **five days per week, with 12-hour shifts including breaks and two days off**?

5. What is your timezone, availability, and earliest start date?

6. What computer will you use, and how reliable is your internet connection?



**Game Knowledge**



Please answer in your own words using specific examples. If you lack experience in a game, say so clearly.



7. **Pet Simulator 99:** How would you deliver gems to a customer? Explain the available delivery methods, any requirements or limitations, and how you would verify the recipient.

8. **Murder Mystery 2:** What is the difference between an item’s rarity and its trading value? Give examples and explain how you would verify the exact weapon or variant before delivery.

9. **Creatures of Sonaria:** What is the difference between a creature species and a stored creature? How does this affect what a customer receives and how you fulfil their order?

10. **Fisch:** How would you determine whether a requested fish or other item can be transferred to a customer? Explain the delivery process and any restrictions you would check.

11. **Blox Fruits:** What is the difference between a physical fruit and a permanent fruit? Explain how delivery differs and what trading requirements or restrictions you would check.

12. **Order Accuracy:** A customer’s display name differs from their username, and several similar accounts appear in search. What would you do before delivering?

13. **Catalogue Research:** How would you d
 which items to add to our catalogue and price them? Explain how you would check demand, value, availability, and delivery feasibility.

title: Part-Time VPS / Hosting Technical Support – Weekend Coverage
description:
Job Description



We are a small, established U.S.-based VPS and infrastructure hosting provider looking for a part-time technical support contractor to provide primarily weekend customer support coverage.



This role is focused on customer-facing technical support through WHMCS. Typical work includes responding to support tickets, basic VPS troubleshooting, reboot and reinstall assistance, DNS and rDNS questions, account/service questions, provisioning issues, and other common VPS and hosting support requests.



You will initially have access to WHMCS and VPS management platforms such as SolusVM and SynergyCP.

This is not a server administrator or infrastructure engineering position. You will not initially have SSH/root access, hypervisor access, network device access, or physical server access. More complex infrastructure issues should be identified, documented clearly, and escalated rather than guessed at or changed without authorization.



We are looking for someone with previous experience in VPS hosting, web hosting technical support, or a similar environment.

Experience with any of the following is strongly preferred:



- WHMCS

- SolusVM

- Linux VPS hosting

- DNS / rDNS

- cPanel

- DirectAdmin

- SynergyCP

- General hosting troubleshooting



The most important qualities for this role are clear written English, reliability, sound judgment, good customer service, and knowing when to escalate an issue rather than guessing.



Schedule



Approximately 8 hours per week, primarily on Saturdays and Sundays.



The work does not necessarily require sitting online continuously for a fixed shift. The goal is consistent ticket coverage throughout agreed support windows, checking the queue at reasonable intervals and responding to customers promptly.



Occasional additional paid hours may be available for vacation coverage, higher-than-normal ticket volume, or other coverage needs.



Pay

$5.50/hour to start, with room to increase based on experience and performance.



This position will begin with a paid trial period.



When applying, please include:



1. A short summary of your previous VPS, web hosting, or technical support experience.

2. Any experience you have with WHMCS, SolusVM, SynergyCP, cPanel, DirectAdmin, Linux VPS environments, DNS, or similar platforms.

3. Your normal availability on Saturdays and Sundays.

4. Whether you are comfortable working approximately 8 hours per week, with occasional additional paid hours.

5. A brief answer to the following scenario:

A customer says their VPS is offline, but the VPS control panel shows the VPS as running. You do not have SSH access to the VPS or the physical/hypervisor server. What would you check, what actions would you take, and how would you respond to the customer?



Please answer the questions above directly in your application.

title: Remote Call Center Agent / Patient Consultation Coordinator
description:
U.S.-Based Medical & Cosmetic Surgery Practice | Remote – Philippines



We are a growing U.S.-based medical and cosmetic surgery practice seeking an experienced and highly motivated Remote Call Center Agent / Patient Consultation Coordinator based in the Philippines.



This is a commission-based, performance-driven position for someone who is confident on the phone, highly organized, persistent with follow-up, and motivated by results.



You will work directly with our U.S.-based practice. This is not a BPO, staffing agency, or third-party call center position.



Your Role

As our Call Center Agent, you will take ownership of prospective patient leads and manage them throughout the entire consultation process.

Once a lead is assigned to you, you are responsible for that lead from initial contact through the completed consultation.



This includes:

• Contacting new leads promptly

• Making multiple follow-up attempts when a lead does not initially respond

• Speaking professionally with prospective patients and building rapport

• Answering basic questions using information and scripts provided by our practice

• Scheduling consultations

• Following up with patients after scheduling

• Confirming upcoming consultations

• Reminding patients about their appointments

• Rescheduling patients when necessary

• Following up with patients who may be at risk of not attending

• Helping reduce cancellations and no-shows

• Maintaining accurate records and notes in Salesforce

• Managing your assigned leads consistently until they complete their consultation or are otherwise closed out

Your responsibility does not end when you schedule the appointment. The goal is to successfully move the prospective patient from initial inquiry to a completed consultation.



Compensation – $15 USD Per Completed Consultation



This is a commission-based position.

You will earn $15 USD for every assigned lead who completes their scheduled consultation.



A commission is earned only after the prospective patient attends and completes the consultation.



For example:

10 completed consultations = $150 USD

25 completed consultations = $375 USD

50 completed consultations = $750 USD

100 completed consultations = $1,500 USD



There is no set limit on the number of qualifying completed consultations you can generate.



Because you will own your assigned leads throughout the process, your earnings will be directly connected to your ability to:

Contact → Engage → Schedule → Confirm → Complete



Simply scheduling an appointment does not qualify for commission. You are expected to maintain communication with your scheduled patients, confirm their appointments, and actively work to help reduce cancellations and no-shows.



Our practice generates a high volume of incoming leads, providing significant earning potential for an agent who is consistent, organized, persistent, and effective at converting leads into completed consultations.



Who We're Looking For

We are especially interested in candidates with previous experience in:

• Call centers or BPO environments

• Appointment setting

• Outbound calling

• Lead conversion

• Sales

• Patient coordination

• Healthcare, medical, dental, cosmetic surgery, or similar industries

• U.S.-based customer service or sales accounts

Experience with Salesforce or another CRM is strongly preferred.



The ideal candidate has:

• Excellent spoken and written English

• A clear, professional, and friendly telephone voice

• Confidence speaking with prospective patients

• Strong sales and relationship-building skills

• Excellent follow-up skills

• Persistence without being overly aggressive

• The ability to handle objections professionally

• Strong organization and attention to detail

• The ability to manage a large volume of leads

• Reliable high-speed internet

• A quiet and professional remote working environment

• A reliable computer and headset

• Availability during designated U.S. Eastern Time hours



Performance Expectations

Success in this position will be measured primarily by:

• Consistent and timely lead follow-up

• Consultations scheduled

• Completed consultations

• Consultation completion/show rate

• Accurate Salesforce documentation

• Professional communication with prospective patients



Our goal is not simply to schedule as many appointments as possible. We want qualified prospective patients who actually attend their consultations.



How to Apply

Please submit:

1. Your resume

2. A brief description of your call center, appointment-setting, sales, or patient coordination experience

3. Details about any experience working with U.S.-based customers or patients

4. Your experience with Salesforce or other CRM systems, if applicable

5. A 60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a good fit for this position



In your application, please also briefly describe how you would follow up with a prospective patient who scheduled a consultation but has not responded to confirmation attempts.



Please do not apply on behalf of an agency, BPO, or team. We are hiring one individual agent who will work directly with our practice and take ownership of assigned leads.
